title: Prompt contracts and rollback orchestration for segmented canaries
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Goal: implement a model lifecycle mechanism that enforces prompt-set contracts (anchored eval suites) for segmented/targeted canaries, supports shadow and A/B traffic, and performs automated quarantine or rollback when quality regressions exceed configurable thresholds. Background: current canary flow ramps traffic without a structured per-prompt contract; regressions are caught reactively after customer reports. This work provides deterministic, per-cohort quality checks tied to canonical anchor prompts and an orchestration layer to automatically quarantine or rollback variants before wider exposure. Success criteria: (1) canary traffic can be scoped by customer/cohort and attached to an anchor prompt contract; (2) system detects per-prompt and aggregate quality regressions with tunable thresholds; (3) automated actions (quarantine, rollback, manual-review pause) execute reliably and are auditable; (4) observability surfaces cause, affected cohorts, and delta magnitudes in the Console. Acceptance criteria: schema for anchor prompt contracts defined and stored; sampling/replication pipeline for shadow traffic implemented; per-prompt score and aggregate score computed in near real-time (<=2m latency from response); orchestration actions codified with safe defaults (quarantine at 3 sigma+ or aggregate drop >5 pts); runbook and dashboard published.
updates: 2026-02-20 - RFC created: proposed 'prompt contract' resource that binds an anchor prompt set, scoring function, and gating policy to a rollout cohort. Initial doc linked.

2026-02-28 - Prototype: sampling shim added to the router to mirror 100% of canary traffic into the eval pipeline for the new cohort 'checkout-mlp-test'. End-to-end latency for mirrored path measured at +1.1s median.

2026-03-03 - Scoring: implemented a unified score vector (semantic_similarity, hallucination_indicator, format_compliance, safety_score). Chose cosine similarity on sentence-embedding + heuristic hallucination detector as primary signals. Tuned on historical regressions to reduce false positives.

2026-03-06 - Gating policy defined: per-prompt alarm when semantic_similarity drop >0.12 or safety_score drop >0.08. Aggregate gate triggers when weighted_mean_score drops >0.05 for 30m window. Configurable cooldown to prevent oscillation.

2026-03-08 - Orchestration: built controller to take actions - 'quarantine' (route cohort to previous pinned variant), 'pause' (halt ramp and notify reviewers), 'rollback' (automated flip back to previous stable variant). Actions write an audit event and create a Console incident link.
2026-03-10 - Integration: added event hooks for the Console to render per-cohort scorecards; Grafana dashboard created with panels for per-prompt deltas, cohort exposure, and recent actions.

2026-03-12 - Safety review: initial internal review complete. Edge cases identified: low-sample cohorts produce noisy scores; plan to require min_sample_count=50 before automated rollback. Next: harden debounce logic and add SLA guard for high-priority customers.
Pending - Add UI for editing gating policies per project and integrate with RBAC so only admins can change auto-rollback thresholds. Also add e2e tests for shadowed canary flows.
